cases.summary: Misleading comment about where the queue starts and its size
cases.description:
Hello,

IIUC, the virtqueue starts at QUEUE_BASE_ADDRESS, which is not `0`. So the comment shall state that. The comment is at 
https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/blob/94826a8d7de32fc871945b7ee088f1f7d3c8a4cc/src/vmm/src/devices/virtio/queue.rs#L879

Also QUEUE_END is not the size if the starting address is not zero so the definition at https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/blob/94826a8d7de32fc871945b7ee088f1f7d3c8a4cc/src/vmm/src/devices/virtio/queue.rs#L809 may be wrong.  

Thanks.

evidence.eventual_fix_title: fix: clarify comments in kani module
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
fix: clarify comments in kani module

QUEUE_END is the address of the first byte past the end of our queue indeed, but the queue doesnt start at 0 (it starts at QUEUE_BASE_ADDRESS, which is 512), and thus GUEST_MEMORY_SIZE was 512 byte too large, because it assumed QUEUE_END was also the size of the queue.

Closes #4997

Reported-by: Matias Ezequiel Vara Larsen <mvaralar@redhat.com>
